description: Block or allow outbound traffic from a staging site: `block_email` stops it emailing real customers, `block_api_requests` stops outbound WordPress HTTP requests (payment gateways, CRMs, webhooks). New staging sites block email and allow API requests. Ask before unblocking email.

domain.description: Domain of the Cloud for WordPress site, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

name: set_wordpress_staging_outbound
title: Set Wordpress Staging Outbound
